ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.description: Can pass through physical matter; only affected by magical attacks

naturalArmor.name: Natural Armor
naturalArmor.description: Thick hide, scales, or carapace provides inherent protection

immunityToElement.name: Immunity to Element
immunityToElement.description: Immune to fire, cold, lightning, acid, etc.

immunityToMagic.name: Immunity to Magic
immunityToMagic.description: Magic has no effect on this creature

damageReduction.name: Damage Reduction
damageReduction.description: Physical damage is reduced by a certain amount

spellResistance.name: Spell Resistance
spellResistance.description: Spells have difficulty affecting this creature
spellResistance.effect: Add +X to Challenge roll to resist spells

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Creature heals rapidly unless specific conditions are met
regeneration.effect: Regain 1d4 HP per round; fire/acid halts regeneration

fastHealing.name: Fast Healing
fastHealing.effect: Regain 1d6 HP between encounters or per long rest

secondaryAttack.description: Can make an additional attack with a secondary weapon or natural attack

followUpAttack.description: If primary attack hits, automatic secondary effect triggers

specialMovement: Hover (stay in place in the air)
